description.value: The Cloverdale Sport & Ice Complex is a City of Surrey municipal recreation facility in the Cloverdale neighbourhood offering multiple ice sheets for hockey, figure skating, public lessons, and skating sessions, with dry-floor summer conversion for lacrosse and ball hockey. Operated by the City of Surrey, the complex features outdoor amenities, landscaping, and ample vehicle parking. A touring cyclist passing through Cloverdale could visit as a local recreational attraction, though it is primarily a community sports facility.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The primary evidence source is the City of Surrey capital projects page for this facility. The page uses mixed tense ('will expand recreation opportunities' alongside 'provides additional ice'), suggesting this may be a project-in-progress page rather than a live operational facility page, which limits confirmable amenity detail. No phone, cycling amenities, washrooms, or bike parking are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content; OSM tags confirm an ice rink but add no amenity detail beyond sport type.
concerns: Website is a capital projects planning page, not an operational facility page; future tense language ('will expand recreation opportunities') raises uncertainty about whether the facility was open at time of content capture.
No phone number present in OSM or retrievable from website content.
Address in OSM lacks postal code; website does not confirm street address.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere in the available content — all required criteria are unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The only available web content is a City of Surrey capital projects planning page with mixed tense language ('will expand' vs. 'provides'), making operational status unclear and leaving all required WWC amenities unconfirmed. A human reviewer should check whether the facility is open and verify cycling-relevant amenities via an operational facility page or on-site visit before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: For a fuller listing, the City of Surrey Parks & Recreation facility directory (surrey.ca/parks-recreation) or a direct facility phone number would provide operational amenity details.
